check_box.label: Split long sounds into equal-length parts
check_box.name: long_sound_equal_splits_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Sounds over the clip limit upload as numbered parts. Unchecked: each part is max length with a shorter final part. Checked: all parts are cut to near-equal length.

check_box.label: Normalize loudness of downloaded sounds (background, patches playing sounds live)
check_box.name: normalize_downloaded_sounds_prefs
check_box.tool_tip: Check downloaded sound assets against the target loudness on the thread pool. Sounds always play immediately; if one needed adjusting, it is hot-swapped mid-playback where it left off and the sound cache is updated. Viewer UI sounds are never processed.

slider.name: target_lufs_slider
slider.tool_tip: -23 LUFS matches the EBU R128 / games loudness standard

spinner.name: target_lufs_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: -23 LUFS matches the EBU R128 / games loudness standard
